description: An unpredictable, concealed reward delivered contingent on meeting a behavioral or academic criterion, using uncertainty itself as a motivational amplifier.
title: Mystery Motivator

description: Learners are challenged to guess the emotion the instructor is acting out in order to solve the mystery of what it is.
title: Mystery Emotion

description: For younger students or the general public who are not able to or not interested in astronomical calculations, the team developed use cases using the Stellarium sky browser.
title: Use myth-refutation sky-browser activities (e.g. the 2012 doomsday claim) for learners not doing calculations
